item.title: Airman rescue shows US can penetrate enemy territory 'anywhere' in Iran, former Pentagon official warns
item.summary: Retired Navy captain and former Pentagon official Brent Sadler says the daring rescue of a downed U.S. airman in Iran sends a powerful warning to Tehran's leadership.

item.title: Retired F-16 pilot says rescued US airman's survival in Iran highlights intense evasion training
item.summary: A U.S. airman survived days in enemy territory before being rescued, highlighting the high-stakes training fighter pilots undergo.

item.title: White House faith advisor says Americans are leaving organized religion but not losing faith in God
item.summary: Paula White-Cain delivers an Easter message of hope and redemption while pushing back on data showing declining religious affiliation in the U.S.

item.title: Reese Witherspoon’s daughter lands surprise role with Miranda Lambert in Ella Langley’s ‘Choosin’ Texas’ video
item.summary: Ava Phillippe follows in her famous parents' footsteps with a starring role in country star Ella Langley's hit "Choosin' Texas" music video release.

item.title: Android flaw lets hackers unlock phones in under a minute
item.summary: Researchers say a serious Android vulnerability affecting certain MediaTek processors could let attackers bypass your lock screen and steal data.

item.title: RFK Jr, EPA chief 'declare war' on microplastics amid growing evidence of health risks
item.summary: RFK Jr. and the EPA head "declare war" on microplastics, adding them to the drinking water contaminants list and launching new health studies.

item.title: Lola Vice ascends to top of WWE NXT women's division, picking up women's title at Stand & Deliver
item.summary: Lola Vice wins the NXT Women's Championship in a triple threat match against Jacy Jayne and Kendal Grey at WWE NXT Stand & Deliver in St. Louis.

item.title: Tony D'Angelo stands tall as NXT champion after brutal four-way match at Stand & Deliver
item.summary: Tony D'Angelo won the NXT Championship at Stand & Deliver, defeating Joe Hendry, Ethan Page and Ricky Saints in a brutal fatal four-way match.

item.title: Inside Iran’s ruling ideology: How a ‘holy mission’ and messianic doctrine fuel regime extremism
item.summary: Iranian journalist says Iran's regime uses messianic Mahdi doctrine to claim divine authority and make political compromise nearly impossible.

item.title: Billboard trolling Dale Warner goes viral after his murder conviction in wife Dee's case
item.summary: A Michigan billboard reading "Help Dale Find Dee" is going viral after Dale Warner was convicted of second-degree murder in his wife's 2021 disappearance.
